questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word.

(The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must not be related to each other based on the number of letters/number of consonants/vowels in the word)

Annual : Semi-annual :: Monthly : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: **Second is half part of the first one.

 
• Annual : Semi-annual → Semi-annual is half of Annual.

Similarly,

 
• Monthly : ? → Fortnightly is half of monthly.

Hence, '**Fortnightly**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the below equation mathematically correct?

104 ÷ 13 + 78 - 3 × 2 = 143

Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All flowers are leaves.

All leaves are stems.

Some stems are roots.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some stems are leaves.

II. Some flowers are roots.

III. Some leaves are flowers.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow
Only conclusions I and III follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/79a649d46549648ad1cbe96f647ae9e4e19d49a30bf48115f1b16c2c083712c7.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some stems are leaves. → **Follows** (As, All flowers are leaves and All leaves are stems)

II. Some flowers are roots. → Does not follow (It is possible, but it is not definite)

III. Some leaves are flowers. → Follows (As, All flowers are leaves)

Hence, '**Only conclusions I and III follow**' is the correct answer.

questions.question: Seven people are sitting in a movie theatre watching a movie facing North. D is sitting towards right of A but towards left of G. Y is sitting towards right of C and towards left of A. Z is sitting towards left of F and is second from the right end. Who is sitting second from the left end?
questions.solution:
Seven people are sitting in a movie theatre watching a movie facing North.

1. Z is sitting towards left of F and is second from the right end.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0f118919f6fa318ebf5f425d7bf301daf969091424b783f8b2396a37b3ec1bcc.png] 

2. D is sitting towards right of A but towards left of G.

**A D G**

3. Y is sitting towards right of C and towards left of A.

**C Y A**

From 2 and 3, the possible arrangement we get is:

**C Y A D G**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c5b19516471a7eb027b87ba38866fce414ba30d82c7e003a08215d5972551b3a.png] 

Clearly, Y is sitting second from the left end.

Hence, '**Y**' is the correct answer.

questions.question: There are 8 people sitting in a circle facing the centre: A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H. A is sitting to the immediate right of G and immediate left of E. Second to the right of E is C. D is sitting to the immediate left of C. F is sitting to the immediate left of G. H is the immediate neighbour of F and B. Who is sitting to the immediate right of B?
questions.solution:
There are 8 people sitting in a circle facing the centre: **A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H**.

1. A is sitting to the immediate right of G and immediate left of E.

2. Second to the right of E is C.

3. D is sitting to the immediate left of C.

4. F is sitting to the immediate left of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6f5dba7d94b2cb2d4eb947a7ff6c50f206c7a042d9fcb47055e00196d76e7dd5.png] 

5. H is the immediate neighbour of F and B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/492a4231843867a992407a75eb17a5b9948b6913616bb62c9b4b12c5125b3573.png] 

Clearly, H is sitting to the immediate right of B.

Hence, '**H**'
 is the correct answer.
